notes.title: Playtonic games in Cozy Quest event 14th-18th November!
notes.content:
Good day, Playtonic Friends game enjoyers!

Do you happen to have a penchant for cozy games? Of course you do! What better way to escape the persistant horrors of reality than by fully immersing yourself in the fictional whimsy of another world?! 

Coincidentally, in support of this, and our good friend capitalism, a number of (Four, to be precise) Playtonic Friends titles are taking part in the Cozy Quest Steam event, run by our good friends at Secret Mode! 

Let's have a wee gander at what games we're serving to you on a Cozy platter!

[h3]Cattle Country (Open Beta)[/h3]

Play Cattle Country's Open Beta for FREE! It's only running for until the 18th of November so go make the most of that one right now! Travel to a new frontier and settle down among the forests and rivers of Cattle Country, build up your ranch, nurture crops and relationships with your fellow settlers and see what the quieter country life is all about. This one is perfect for fans of farming sims with a cowboy twist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2818150/Cattle_Country

[h3]Lil Gator Game[/h3]

This one needs no introduction! It's Lil Gator Game!

Okay, a bit of introduction... Lil Gator Game places you in charge of, wait for it, a cute Lil Gator, on a journey of adventure and friendship, often combing the two! (Friendventure?) Take on cardboard cut-out "monsters", gather your friends and finally get to play together!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1586800/Lil_Gator_Game/

[h3]Blossom Tales II: The Minotaur Prince[/h3]

Castle Pixel's second entry in this list (They're developing Cattle Country!) is Blossom Tales II! If you're a fan of classic adventure RPGs with a little green guy, this one is for you! Join Lily and slash your way through monster-infested dungeons to save the Kingdom of Blossom from eternal darkness. It's a lot cozier than that sounds... I promise.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/446810/Blossom_Tales_The_Sleeping_King/

[h3]A Little Golf Journey[/h3]

Golf is sport and sport doesn't sound all that cozy or relaxing to me BUT A Little Golf Journey is here to subvert all of my preconceptions! Take on light golfing challenges and puzzles across beautiful diarama based courses. Tweak the settings and difficulty to your desired level, sit back and golf!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1232150/A_Little_Golf_Journey/

Thanks for checking out our lovely little list of Cozy Quest games! If you want to peak at the whole list of games taking part in the event, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/SecretMode/sale/CozyQuest2024]get your clicking finger on this link![/url]

notes.title: Playtonic Friends is coming to WASD! April 25-27
notes.content:
This is Playtonic Friends first physical appearance at WASD and we would love for you to come along and say hi! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40214109/45f4a71f713b79ec3cc380c4db5381dbef1790b4.jpg[/img]

We're bringing FOUR of our latest and greatest Indie bangers for you to get your hands on! First up?

[h1]ELSIE[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515570/Elsie/

Elsie is a technicolor, hyperkinetic, rogue-like action-platformer filled with procedurally generated levels, an army of robots to blast through, and a wide scope of items and weaponry to make each run as unique as possible. Master countless magitek weapons and abilities in order to survive.

Be the first to play a [b]BRAND NEW DEMO[/b] exclusively in person at WASD! 

[h1]VICTORY HEAT RALLY[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1594060/Victory_Heat_Rally/

An intense, retro arcade-style racer that embodies the spirit of classic 90's racing games. Experience high-speed action, vibrant retro aesthetics, and non-stop drifting thrills as you challenge friends-turned-rivals. Get ready for an exhilarating ride!

Always the fan favourite - head over to the booth and test your racing skills on the show floor, or check out the demo, on Steam now!

[h1]CorpoNation: The Sorting Process[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2159960/CorpoNation_The_Sorting_Process/

You have been tasked with sorting the Ringo CorpoNation's genetic samples. With the credits that you earn, you can shop, game and pay your bills on time. Rogue workers may try to entice you into betraying your beloved employer, but we know you'll give 110%.

Come and check out our newest release with over 90% Positive Reviews on Steam! CorpoNation is also [b]coming to Nintendo Switch and Xbox Series X/S on May 9th, 2024![/b]

[h1]Lil Gator Game[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1586800/Lil_Gator_Game/

Embark on an adorable adventure, discover new friends and uncover everything the island has to offer. Climb, Swim, Glide and slide your way into the hearts of the many different characters you meet on your travels!

Head over to the booth and show some love to everyone's favourite Lil Gator Gamer - [b]also now available on Game Pass![/b]

Our lovely Brand Managers Anni and Sophie and super friendly Community Manager Steve can't wait to say hi to you all!

[previewyoutube=5GP1vtjBMtQ;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Speedrun Update is OUT NOW & Lil Gator Plush News
notes.content:
Hey Gator Gang!

Patch, plush, plaudits! Let's take a look at what's going on in the world of Lil Gator.

We've got a brand new content update that'll have you speeding across the mountaintops from one end of the island to the other in the new [b]speedrun mode![/b]

For new members of the Gator Gang we recommend you take your time and savour the experience but if you're up for a challenge you can toggle the speed run timer on in the settings menu.

Already completed your adventure? Why not return and give the new speedrunning mode a go, discover shortcuts or alternative routes and let us know your fastest time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40316559/018428518ae5feb76759da465b31090afd586fa4.jpg[/img]

That's not all! We've been processing the feedback from players and made some quality-of-life updates, such as:
[list]
[*] Foliage no longer obscures the camera as much.
[*] Character quest bugs have been tweaked/fixed.
[*] Text typos have been corrected.
[/list]And more! For the full patch notes please visit the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1586800/discussions/0/3770111689910669513/]forum[/url].

If you run into any unexpected bugs on your adventure please report them in our 'Report a Problem' [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1586800/discussions/1/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]sub forum[/url]. 

[previewyoutube=kXHvtrIaWbU;full][/previewyoutube]
Have you seen the reviews Lil Gator Game has been getting? Take a look at what reviewers are saying about Lil Gator Game in our latest trailer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40316559/ada194b5dec2bb201dbeb422e873d5c230b0c5c3.jpg[/img]

Our last update for you is of the cuddly variety. We've teamed up with Fangamer to bring you your very own Lil Gator plush complete with a hat and detachable sword and shield!

You can [b][url=https://fanga.me/r/lilgatorplush]sign up[/url][/b] now to be notified when they are ready to order.

See you out there gator gang! 


If you haven’t picked Lil Gator Game up yet, you can snag it at a whopping [b]30% off[/b] for a limited time. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1586800/Lil_Gator_Game/

notes.title: How Lil Gator came to life
notes.content:
Hey, gator gang!

Welcome to the first behind-the-screens look at how Lil Gator Game was created! The inspiration, childhood antics and what makes Lil Gator unique.

But first, let's introduce ourselves:
Scott started the ball rolling on this project and is the code, technical art and SFX genius. We are constantly in awe of his talents!
Robin is the game's maestro, but that's not all! He also has a few tricks up his sleeve when it comes to architectural modeling. He played a huge part in designing the game's man-made landmarks.
Connor is an incredible artist who also does character modeling, animation and writes the stories that give your favorite characters their unique voices.


[b]From idea to creation [/b]

Scott always wanted Lil Gator Game to be a Zelda allegory through and through. Link is green, Gator is green. It's as simple as that! Like many players who enjoyed The Legend of Zelda adventures as a kid (and as an adult), we loved how coziness and adventure went hand in hand. Plenty of other indie titles have captured that magic as well, so why not give it a try ourselves? [i]A Short Hike[/i] was a great example of this, inspiring us from both a technical and aesthetic standpoint (we all [i]highly[/i] recommend it).

Before they got replaced by metal and plastic, we all played at old big wooden parks, having adventures with our childhood friends. That feeling of crawling around, finding all the nooks and toys within a towering structure that felt a thousand years old, is at the core of Lil Gator Game. Go on, have an adventure! Get a little lost, climb a little too high, fall and scrape your knee. Someone is waiting for you over on the park bench with a hug and a packed lunch. Everything is gonna be okay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40316559/af849132cf69f91eac2fb76b740588d8fa0dfd25.png[/img]

With an abundance of characters taking part in Lil Gator's game and a few you've already had the pleasure of meeting in multiple trailers, such as Jill, Martin, Avery, and Big Sis, let's get to know Lil Gator a little more.

[b]Meeting Lil Gator[/b]

Lil Gator is on a mission to craft an adventure so awesome that their Big Sis will want to put down her school work and come and play as they did before. Their boundless energy is infectious and manages to band their friends together to help out. Although lil gator isn’t always the most sure of themself, everything just seems to work out when they charge forward with reckless abandon and speak whatever is on their mind! Maybe it's that twinkle in their eye…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40316559/3dd5f51bb223f351eedb0a9a81098f4dd2d6140f.png[/img]

Expect another developer diary soon with some character profiles and even a mini tour around the island. In the meantime, don't forget to wishlist Lil Gator Game and tell your friends :)

Later, gator gang!

- MegaWobble & Playtonic Friends
